remarks: This sparkling and meticulous 2-bedroom, 2 full bath condo provides an unparalleled blend of luxury and convenience. Stunning living space opens to an oversized kitchen with natural sunlight, vaulted ceilings 9ft, rich Mohawk hardwood floors throughout, walk-in closets, and private balcony. The chef-worthy kitchen showcases GE Profile stainless steel appliances with gas range, sleek granite countertops, eat-in island is perfect for entertaining, generous counter space, and storage for culinary essentials. Your primary BR has updated en suite full bath, large walk-in closet, and provides access to your private balcony, 2nd BR with large walk-in closet, 2nd full bath, and in-unit laundry with brand new GE washer/dryer and additional storage. Many updates and upgraded items, including new HVAC, 75-gal HWH w/auto shut-off, garbage disposal, climate control center w/individual room sensors, and keyless entry. This immaculate unit is turnkey and puts you in a prime location near the Stamford train station for an easy commute to NYC, downtown center, city's best restaurants, shopping, beaches, and parks. Amenities include Concierge, gym with 24/7 access, club room, dog walk area, manicured courtyard with gas grills, bike room, and more. Great potential investment property. Secure building uses RFID fobs to access elevator from parking levels and has property-wide video surveillance security system. Unit comes with 2 parking spaces: 1 assigned,1 floater. Must see this pristine unit!
